title: Compose-Dashboard Phase-1 Run Plan
description: Schema for the deterministic 'run plan' artifact emitted by compose-dashboard's phase-1 (compose) step. The run plan is the COMPLETE specification of what phase-2 (execute) and phase-3 (synthesize) will do — without any method execution having happened yet. See plan § Dashboard, Interpretation, and Inference Layers § Implementation discipline for compose-dashboard. Run plans are persisted at data-products/{target}/{indication}/{package_id}/run_plan.yaml as audit trail.

run_plan_id.description: Stable identifier for this run plan emission. Convention: rp-{target}-{indication}-{release_pin}-{data_mode}-{seq}. L1 fix (post-adversarial-review): pattern widened to accept underscores so 'latest_approved' data_mode and 'unpinned' release_pin produce valid ids.

generated_by.description: Skill identifier + git_sha (or version) that emitted this run plan.

input_context.description: The user-supplied inputs to compose-dashboard. Recorded verbatim so the run plan is self-contained.

subgroup_spec.description: Either a list of subgroup_ids, the literal 'all', or null.

axis_resolution.description: How the target's biology axis was resolved.

status.description: resolved = axis found in lookup; unknown = target not in target_biology_axis_lookup.yaml; incompatible = axis found but no iter-1b dashboard base supports it (e.g., extrinsic, mixed).

lookup_source.description: Path or manifest_id of the lookup that produced the axis (e.g., 'target_biology_axis_lookup.yaml').

lookup_rationale.description: Free-text rationale from the lookup entry.

selected_base_dashboard.description: dashboard_spec.dashboard_id of the base loaded for this axis. Null when status != resolved.

fallback_reason.description: When status == unknown or incompatible, structured reason the framework refuses to proceed normally.

modality_resolution.description: How modality was resolved — specified, enumerated, or not applicable.

plausible_modalities.description: When mode == enumerated_plausible, the list of modalities loaded. From modality_axis_compatibility.yaml.plausible_modalities_iter1b for the resolved axis.

loaded_modality_modules.description: Modality modules loaded into this run. Empty when axis_resolution.status != resolved or no plausible modalities exist.

threshold_overlays_summary.description: Per-card-id threshold tuning applied by this module.

synthesis_emphasis.description: Module's synthesis_emphasis block copied verbatim — phase-3 consumes this directly.

modality_specific_caveats.description: The modality module's modality_specific_caveats, carried verbatim so phase-3 synthesis can aggregate them into evidence_package.synthesis.caveats_summary. T7 fix (2026-08-11): the field was previously dropped in compose_phase1._module_summary, so synthesis had nothing to aggregate; this schema entry admits it (the items schema is unevaluatedProperties:false, so the new field must be declared).

subgroup_resolution.description: How the subgroup_spec input was resolved to a catalog + (in phase-2) assignment products.

subgroup_catalog_ref.description: Resolved subgroup_catalog id (e.g., 'coadread-subgroups-2026-q2'). Null when subgroup_spec input was null or no catalog available.

resolved_strata_ids.description: Atomic stratum IDs in scope after resolving 'all' or the supplied subset.

card_run_plan.description: Per-card disposition: cards to run, cards excluded by applies_when at compose time, cards failed (e.g., card_id not found in target-contracts/cards/).

to_run.description: Cards that compose-dashboard's phase-2 will invoke.

source_detail.description: When source == base_optional, the `when:` predicate that admitted it. When source == modality_module_additional, the modality the addition came from.

applied_threshold_overlays.description: Threshold values after merging base card_spec.thresholds with modality_module.threshold_overlays. Per-threshold-name → effective value.

overlay_contributing_modalities.description: Modalities whose threshold_overlays were merged. Empty when no module modified this card's thresholds.

method_invocations.description: Resolved method calls phase-2 will execute (with all template placeholders substituted).

excluded_at_compose.description: Cards excluded at compose time. Includes base optional_cards whose `when:` predicate failed AND cards whose own applies_when context is unsatisfiable from compose-time-known fields (e.g., no subgroup_spec for subgroup-stratified card).

failed_at_compose.description: Cards listed in dashboard_spec or modality_module but whose card_spec_path doesn't resolve, or whose version range doesn't match an available card_spec. THIS IS A FRAMEWORK ERROR — run plan validation should reject runs with non-empty failed_at_compose.

synthesis_directives.description: Material phase-3 (synthesize) consumes. Aggregated from dashboard_spec.synthesis_prompts + all loaded modality_modules' synthesis_emphasis blocks.
